Why Zenvy

Built around how clinics actually run.

Most clinics have one or two doctors and no IT team, and their day runs on walk-ins and paper tokens. Zenvy is designed for that.

Walk-ins come first

Live queue, ETA and a WhatsApp token for walk-ins. No app needed.

No IT team needed

Runs on the phones you already have. We set it up with you at the clinic.

AI that earns the doctor's time

The scribe drafts, the doctor signs. Reminders bring patients back. Recording starts only when the patient allows it.

Your data stays yours

Patient records stay in your clinic. Each clinic sees only its own patients. Never used for marketing or sold.

Planned: export your records anytime.

Paper isn't the problem. Fit is.Shaped by our talks with clinic doctors
